fail_closed_rules: Sold Prior without consideration is not assigned a price.

Past-due rent-review dates are not silently converted into reviewed rents.
Future fixed, RPI-linked and minimum rents are not treated as current income.
Peppercorn and ground rents are not confused with occupational income.
Headline/table rent discrepancies are preserved without forced reconciliation.
Vacant accommodation is not represented as let or income-producing.
Historic planning consent and subject-to-consent development potential are not represented as implemented, subsisting or valued outcomes.
Renewal and freehold-purchase options are not represented as exercised.
Active company status and registered charges do not imply covenant strength or property-level lease performance.
Legal-pack EPC, title, update and lease details are not filled by inference.
No business or parcel row was written by the maintenance/control slot.
